    prefix_sum = defaultdict(int)
    prefix_sum[0] = 1
    total_count = 0

        current_sum += int(char)
        target = current_sum - (len(s) - current_sum + 1)
        total_count += prefix_sum[target]
        prefix_sum[current_sum] += 1
